intro.title: Learning Technology That Works for Students and Staff
paragraphs: Students expect to learn on their phones, anytime. Teachers want simple tools to run classes and track progress. Administrators need admissions, fees, attendance and results in one place. Generic platforms rarely fit all three, and juggling many tools frustrates everyone.

We build education and edtech software around how your institution teaches and runs: LMS and course platforms, e-learning apps, live and hybrid classrooms, online exams and certification, student and parent portals, school and college ERPs, and admission CRMs that turn enquiries into enrolments.

From coaching institutes to universities and edtech startups, we design platforms that scale to thousands of learners. See our <work>education case study</work>, explore <saas>SaaS development</saas> or <contact>talk to us about your institution</contact>.

faqs.title: Education Software Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for schools, institutes and edtech founders.

items.q: What education software do you develop?
items.a: We build LMS and course platforms, e-learning apps, live class systems, online exams, student and parent portals, school and college ERPs and admission CRMs.

items.q: Can you build an e-learning app like popular course apps?
items.a: Yes. We build learning apps with video lessons, offline viewing, quizzes, progress tracking, payments and notifications on Android and iOS.

items.q: Do you build online exam software?
items.a: Yes. We build secure online tests with question banks, timers, auto-grading, result analysis and optional proctoring features.

items.q: Can you build a school ERP?
items.a: Yes. Our school and college ERPs cover admissions, fees, attendance, timetables, exams, transport and parent communication.

items.q: How much does education software cost?
items.a: A course platform or website typically costs $3,000 to $15,000, e-learning apps or institute ERPs $15,000 to $50,000, and edtech platforms $50,000 or more.

items.q: Can the platform handle thousands of students?
items.a: Yes. We design cloud-based platforms that scale for live classes, exams and peak admission periods.
